text:
Which statement is always true?
A
A magnetic material attracts a non-magnetic material.
B
A magnetic material repels another magnetic material.
C
A magnetic material attracts another magnetic material if one of them is magnetised.
D
A non-magnetic material repels another non-magnetic material.

options.label: A
options.text: A magnetic material attracts a non-magnetic material.

options.label: B
options.text: A magnetic material repels another magnetic material.

options.label: C
options.text: A magnetic material attracts another magnetic material if one of them is magnetised.

options.label: D
options.text: A non-magnetic material repels another non-magnetic material.
